job.job_title: Senior AI Platform Engineer - LLM & Agentic Applications
job.job_description:
Role: Senior AI Platform Engineer

Job Type: Full-time

Shift timing: 2 pm to 11 pm

Location: PAN India - Remote

Experience: 8+ Years




Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, build, and deploy production- grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Python application engineering, modern API development, Retrieval- Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agent frameworks, and secure cloud-native deployments.

This role requires hands-on expertise in developing enterprise-scale AI platforms and APIs, with a strong focus on quality, testing, scalability, and security.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade AI applications using Python.
Build scalable REST APIs using FastAPI (or equivalent modern Python frameworks).
Develop and deploy production-ready LLM-powered applications and Agentic AI solutions.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Build intelligent AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning and workflow orchestration.
Develop secure, scalable cloud-native AI services.
Implement AI application testing, evaluation, regression testing, and performance monitoring.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI services into enterprise platforms.
Optimize AI application performance, observability, logging, and reliability.
Follow engineering best practices, documentation standards, and CI/CD processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Must Have

8+ years of overall software engineering experience.
Python 6+ years (Primary programming language).
FastAPI 2+ years (or equivalent modern Python API framework).
LLM / Generative AI 3+ years building production-grade enterprise AI applications.
Agentic AI / AI Agents – 1+ year (2+ years preferred).
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) – 2+ years.
Experience developing production-grade REST APIs.


Experience deploying secure cloud-native AI applications.
Strong understanding of AI application architecture, testing, and evaluation.

Pydantic
React
TypeScript
Document & Evidence Engineering (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF, OOXML)

AI Evaluation Frameworks

AI-assisted Software Engineering
Documentation & Refactoring



Nice-to-Have Experience

Enterprise document intelligence solutions.
Multi-agent AI systems.
Cloud-native deployment architectures.
End-to-end AI platform engineering.
